moving_source.name: Moving Sound Source
moving_source.description: Object translating through the medium at speed vs while periodically emitting spherical sound waves at source frequency fs.

compressed_wavefronts.name: Compressed Wavefronts (Ahead)
compressed_wavefronts.description: Wavefronts crowded together ahead of the moving source; observed wavelength λL is shorter, resulting in higher observed frequency fL > fs.

stretched_wavefronts.name: Dilated / Stretched Wavefronts (Behind)
stretched_wavefronts.description: Wavefronts spaced further apart behind the moving source; observed wavelength λL is longer, resulting in lower observed frequency fL < fs.

observer_ahead.name: Stationary Observer Ahead (Approaching)
observer_ahead.description: Stationary listener towards whom the source approaches; intercepts wavefronts at a higher rate, perceiving a higher frequency (higher pitch).

observer_behind.name: Stationary Observer Behind (Receding)
observer_behind.description: Stationary listener from whom the source moves away; intercepts wavefronts at a lower rate, perceiving a lower frequency (lower pitch).

source_velocity_vector.name: Source Velocity Vector (vs)
source_velocity_vector.description: Vector representing the translational velocity of the sound source moving towards the right.

sound_wave_speed.name: Medium Sound Speed (v)
sound_wave_speed.description: Speed at which acoustic disturbances propagate symmetrically through the stationary air medium (approx 340 m·s⁻¹).
